title: Actions File Serialization Format
description: JSON Schema for the canonical serialization of .actions files. Field names mirror the v4 actions ontology (https://clearhead.us/vocab/actions/v4) minus the 'has' prefix, so a single grep connects a serialized field to its ontology property and its .actions DSL token.

id.description: hasUUID — '#' in the DSL. UUIDv7 preferred.

name.description: rdfs:label — the decoded semantic title, after DSL escapes are removed.

description.description: Decoded long-form description — '$ ... $' in the DSL.

priority.description: hasPriority — '!' in the DSL. RFC 5545-aligned, 1 (highest) to 9 (lowest).

scheduledDateTime.description: hasScheduledDateTime — '@' in the DSL. ISO 8601 local lower bound of the Action's feasible execution range; the Action is not intended to be worked before this value. Effective bounds inherited from ancestors are derived and are not serialized here.

dueDateTime.description: hasDueDateTime — ':' in the DSL. ISO 8601 local upper bound of the Action's feasible execution range; the Action is intended to be completed no later than this value. Effective bounds inherited from ancestors are derived and are not serialized here.

completedDateTime.description: hasCompletedDateTime — '%' in the DSL. ISO 8601 completion time.

createdDateTime.description: hasCreatedDateTime — '^' in the DSL. ISO 8601 creation time.

charter.description: Decoded charter membership hint — '*' in the DSL.

sequentialChildren.description: hasSequentialChildren — '~' in the DSL. When true, each child implicitly depends on the previous sibling completing.

predecessors.description: Dependency references — '<' in the DSL. A canonical UUID or unresolved alias is preserved as semantic reference text.

externalScheduleId.description: hasExternalScheduleId — external schedule-series identifier (e.g. an ICS UID).

externalOccurrenceKey.description: hasExternalOccurrenceKey — external occurrence-level identifier within a series.

parentId.description: UUID of the parent action ('>' nesting in the DSL).

children.description: Nested child actions ('>' depth in the DSL).
